temperature_profiles.note: Wall temperatures digitised from Liu et al. (2025), as in the manuscript; source region of the computations (manuscript Sec. 4.1).

model_sketch.note: Wall temperature of the pure PbI2 steel column digitised from Liu et al. (2025); release region x = 9-10.5 cm, r = 0.25R-0.75R (manuscript Sec. 4.1); wall law of manuscript Eqs. (4)-(5), Fig. 2.

graetz.note: Graetz-Robin records (manuscript Sec. 5.1): linear advection, zeroGradient outlet; circles Bi = 1, squares Bi = 50.

damkohler.note: Damkoehler sweep of run/016 (manuscript Sec. 4.2): flux at x = 84.5 mm against Da at the onset temperature; grey: tube Da of the column cases for alpha = 0.01, 0.1, 1 (manuscript Sec. 4.2 text).

field.note: PbI2(g) saturation ratio S = x/x_eq(T_w) in the pure PbI2 steel column at 60 s, production run (41,472 cells, limitedLinear; manuscript Sec. 4.2, Fig. deposition_field).

sensitivity.note: Production-scheme sensitivities of run/024 (41,472 cells, limitedLinear), each against its own baseline; blue: diffusivity, orange: accommodation.

lobresco_onset.note: Manuscript Table V (results.json, lobresco2026): onset by the 1 % rule on the main deposit; published model values from Lobresco et al. (2026), Table 2.

liu_profiles.note: Production runs of run/024 (576 x 72, limitedLinear, steel Q1 baselines); measured scan digitised from Liu et al. (2025) as in the manuscript.

silica.note: Production runs of run/024, silica Q1, published and shifted temperature curves; overlap from results.json (alignment); measured scan digitised from Liu et al. (2025).

thermodynamics.note: results.json (chemistry): Q2 cases; dashed: published iodide-I split (analysis.json of the production runs); the +29 kJ/mol branch is a surrogate perturbation, not a qualified dataset (manuscript Fig. thermo).
